summary: AMETEK filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an offering of two series of unsecured senior notes (amounts, coupons and maturities left blank). It states net proceeds, together with concurrent securities offerings, will repay borrowings under financing agreements and/or commercial paper and fund general corporate purposes. The debt funded the previously completed $5 billion cash acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation, signed May 5, 2026 and closed August 26, 2026 — disclosed background, not a new event. Notes carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase and NYSE listing application. Watch pricing, leverage reduction and any concurrent equity-linked tranche.
